posts.name: EvanDan55
posts.cooked:
Well, we do have a list. It's just in the EE rulebook, so everyone probably doesn't have it yet.

Okay, I'm totally behind on the whole "Omnitron's nemesis is part of himself". When did this happen? What card? I can't believe I'm this far behind.

But yes, we definitely have Plague Rat's nemesis figured out. I put it together like the second day I had Rook City. But then again, it really wasn't hidden. He was where you'd expect to find him - Plague Rat's deck. No big deal. I think he was hidden much more cleverly in Akash'Bhuta's deck. That one was a nice little surprise.

For a while, I thought FrightTrain might have been Bunker's nemesis (I think it was a post by me that Christopher responded to that gave us the name), but obviously now we know that's not true, and that's probably a good thing. I can't see how a villain deck could be made with FrightTrain as the villain. What kind of cards could he possibly have? He's just a background character.

As for my guess to Bunker's real nemesis... I have none. Not a single clue.

The easiest answer for Ab. Zero's nemesis would be to say it'd be a fire-based villain, but I feel like the >G guys know that's what we're all thinking, and they'll throw us a curveball. Plus, if it was a fire-based villain, Ab. Zero would be able to use some of his cards to redirect damage back to him, and Ra would be totally immune with "Flesh of the Sun God." 

For Unity, I've got nothing as well.

But Visionary... I think I've got it. And most of you probably do too. You know how in her bio on the site it mentions some sort of alternate version of herself that's in her own mind? It's probably that "Evil Visionary". That other side of her is in a ton of the art featuring Visionary. It's even at the bottom of her bio, and on her incapacitated side.
